title: Warn Salespeople That a Product Will Soon be Out of Stock

chapters.title: Demo - viewing the warning on a sales order
Demand impact of unposted sales lines

features.name: Stock out warning on sales lines
features.description: Business Central displays a message warning users when entering a sales line quantity that would result in negative inventory at the chosen location if the order was posted.
caveats: warning appears only when posting would result in negative inventory
unposted sales lines still affect demand calculations

features.name: Stock out warning toggle
features.description: A field called 'stock out warning' in the Sales and Receivables Setup page that determines whether users see warnings when entering quantities on sales lines that would deplete inventory.
caveats: can be toggled on or off per company setup

quotes.text: People who enter sales documents in Business Central should always be able to enter new orders and invoices and not necessarily have to worry
quotes.why_it_matters: Establishes the design principle that users should not be blocked from entering sales orders regardless of inventory status

quotes.text: by default, Business Central will display a message that it warns users about the would-be negative inventory level when registering the sales line
quotes.why_it_matters: Defines the default behavior of the stock out warning system in the product

quotes.text: the quantity I enter here, even if the order is not posted yet, it will have an effect on the demand of this product
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains that unposted sales line quantities affect system demand calculations, not just posted inventory

quotes.text: stock out warning. This is the field that determines whether or not I see that warning when I try to enter and quantity on
quotes.why_it_matters: Identifies the specific setup field that controls whether warnings appear to users
